File `src/modules/balance/balance.repository.ts` exists and exports: `ILeaveBalanceRepository` interface with methods findByEmployeePolicyFiscalYear(employeeId, policyId, fiscalYear), findById(id), create(dto), updateUsedDays(id, usedDays), findAllByEmployeeId(employeeId); and `IBalanceAdjustmentRepository` interface with methods findByLeaveBalanceId(leaveBalanceId), create(dto), updateStatus(id, status, appliedAt).

constraints: All TypeScript code must use strict mode — no implicit any, strict null checks enforced.
No `any` type usage; use `unknown` with type guards instead (HARNESS.json constraint id=no-any).
Repository interfaces must be pure abstractions — no implementation, no database access, no Knex imports.
Module files must follow the naming convention: `src/modules/balance/balance.{model,repository}.ts`.
outOfScope: Database migrations (Knex) for leave_balances and balance_adjustments tables — deferred to Phase 2.
Knex repository implementations (KnexLeaveBalanceRepository, KnexBalanceAdjustmentRepository) — deferred to Phase 3 and Phase 5.
Balance service interface (IBalanceService) and implementation (BalanceService) — deferred to Phase 4.
Balance controller, routes, module barrel export, and app registration — deferred to Phases 5–7.
Business rule enforcement (BR-003 through BR-012) — these are implemented in the service layer (Phase 4), not in the model/repository interfaces.
Audit logging (GP-002) — audit records are produced by the service layer, not by model definitions or repository interfaces.

ambiguities.description: The `remainingDays` field on `LeaveBalance` is described as "derived as totalEntitlement - usedDays". Since TypeScript interfaces cannot enforce derivation logic, it is ambiguous whether this should be: (a) a readonly property computed at object construction time, (b) a getter on a class implementation, or (c) simply a field that consumers are expected to compute. The ARCHITECTURE.md BR-002 clarifies it is "never stored independently" but does not prescribe the interface-level representation.
options: Declare remainingDays as a readonly field in the interface; consumers compute it at construction time
Omit remainingDays from the interface and provide a helper function getRemainingDays(balance)
Keep remainingDays as a regular field in the interface and document that it must equal totalEntitlement - usedDays
